# TaiBu Core provenance

Source https://github.com/hhszzzz/taibu/tree/4b2a51a/packages/core

Vendored from commit 4b2a51a, package version 4.1.0. Upstream source is unchanged.
Core LICENSE (MIT), THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md and ALGORITHM_RULES.md are retained.
The application and other upstream AGPL components have not been copied.
package-lock.json pins installation dependencies. dist is built locally.

The adapter uses bazi, almanac and bazi relations. Other core domains remain in
this upstream package to preserve its build and imports; they are not enabled
as My Fortune features.
